criteria.description: Docker desired-state apply delegates runtime lookup and mutating operations to DockerControlClient.
Docker-compatible Engine API create/start/stop/remove/pull/network-connect control operations are owned by dockerEngineControlClient.
Execution mode is sourced from the control client and surfaced in DesiredStateApplyResult.
Business logic for Docker legacy Deploy no longer performs create/start/pull mutations directly in docker.go and delegates those mutations to the control client.
